_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-64 base rate on ±2-point moves makes HOLD the statistically honest default — the August 2024 analog and weakening DXY support an eventual Disbelief transition, but with MVRV unwashed and Fed liquidity at zero, forcing direction here is a guess at a breaker nobody has confirmed yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both agree current phase is Denial and both lean bullish on eventual resolution, but the analyst explicitly forward-calls Disbelief with medium conviction while the narrative implies upward mean reversion without naming the next phase; neither brain calls for immediate directional action.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $65,500 with funding staying below 0.01% and VIX compressing under 13, validating Denial→Disbelief→Hope transition with organic spot bid
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $61,000 with exchange netflow spiking above 85 and funding flipping negative, forcing retest toward Anxiety as liquidity drain overwhelms momentum
